hook: Holden's last hero vs Ford's final GT. Not just a power war.
cta: Which one's going in the shed? 👇

stories.a: The LS9 is the C6 Corvette ZR1's engine family, so LS parts are everywhere. But it's a 300-car collectable.
stories.b: The Miami is a hand-built, Coyote-based 5.0 with a forged crank and six-bolt mains. No factory intercooler, so big boost needs work.
stories.take: Our take: the GT F is the one you'd actually spanner on.

stories.a: 300 built, all pre-sold at $169,990. LS9 fitted at HSV's Clayton plant, SupaShock coil-overs, carbon wing and vents, Pirelli Trofeo R track tyres.
stories.b: 351 kW with overboost bursts to 404 kW, plus launch control. R-SPEC chassis: firmer strut mounts, thicker rear bar, 9-inch rear rubber. 500 for Australia.
stories.take: One's a road-legal race car. One's the GT that closed the book.
